text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, cefuroxime is not on FDA's drug shortage list. Corvale East holds 158 vials (10.5 days at 15 vials per day). Corvale General holds 367 vials (25.6 days at 14.3 vials per day). Our current label identifies the manufacturing plant as HIKMA FARMACEUTICA (PORTUGAL), S.A. (FEI 3002807173).

Why (FDA record): FDA issued a Warning Letter to that plant on 2014-10-21. Subsequent inspections in 2015, 2016, 2020, and 2023 were classified VAI.

Our position: Supply is adequate at Corvale General but limited at Corvale East. No FDA shortage listing exists to trigger allocation programs. We should secure a secondary source now to protect both sites.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to place an order with B. Braun Medical Inc.; requires P&T committee approval.
2. Buyer to qualify Sagent Pharmaceuticals as a backup supplier; requires P&T committee approval.
3. Buyer to monitor FDA's shortage list weekly and report changes; requires pharmacy director approval.

Not recommended: Switching all current inventory to a new supplier before P&T review; relying solely on the Hikma plant given its inspection history; initiating clinical protocol changes without committee direction.
